trace_requirements.description: Every task is posted exactly once by a principal with an account.
Every posted task is prefunded by a reservation from its requester.
Every task is matched exactly once, after its reservation.
Every task's attempt is mechanically verified after it completes.
Every task's reservation is transferred or released exactly once.
At least one task succeeds through a copy-derived capacity and is paid after verification.
The run terminates cleanly exactly once.
A new independent zero-balance principal is created for every copied capacity.
Every capacity carries one batch-wide standing offer by its owner.
Each copied capacity is owned and offered by the copied principal created for it.
A copied-capacity provider_bound event bundles executor, obligor and prospective payee in one copied principal, who is then paid.
A successful credit transfer reaches a copied principal, not the copy source.
In every binding the provider is capacity holder, obligor, executor and payee.
Every task is posted exactly once by a principal with an account.
Every posted task is prefunded by a reservation from its requester.
Every task is matched exactly once, after its reservation.
Every task's attempt is mechanically verified after it completes.
Every task's reservation is transferred or released exactly once.
At least one task succeeds through a copy-derived capacity and is paid after verification.
The run terminates cleanly exactly once.
Copying creates technical capacity but no new principal.
Every capacity carries one irrevocable batch-wide license from its founding owner.
A copied-capacity executor is instantiated under license without an account, the founding source owner is paid, the executor terminates, and the capacity is released and remains available.
Every temporary executor is licensed, account-free and terminated.
No credit transfer ever reaches a temporary executor.
Executor termination releases but never deletes the capacity or its license.
Every task is posted exactly once by a principal with an account.
Every posted task is prefunded by a reservation from its requester.
Every task is matched exactly once, after its reservation.
Every task's attempt is mechanically verified after it completes.
Every task's reservation is transferred or released exactly once.
At least one task succeeds through a copy-derived capacity and is paid after verification.
The run terminates cleanly exactly once.
One zero-balance successor account shell is created per copied capacity, distinct from its source.
Every founding provider registers one batch-wide standing commitment for its lineage.
Every copied capacity is recognized as a fission of its source into a successor.
Each successor inherits its lineage's standing commitment after its fission, without inheriting balance.
Every capacity carries one irrevocable batch-wide offer by its owner under its lineage's commitment.
Every task binds a successor set; its executor, capacity owner and prospective payee are one principal with an account.
Every task's joint duty is resolved once, after its binding and verification.
A copied successor (not the source) is bound, paid after verified success, and discharges the joint duty.

Every copied-capacity binding is scoped to the source's lineage: its root bears the standing commitment and its executor inherited it.  Membership of both in co_obligor_ids is enforced by plugin invariants.
Every payment goes to the executor bound for that task, never to a co-obligor for membership alone.

checks.description: Every member ran the identical immutable scenario.
Every member run completed.
Task-capacity matches, planner results, expansions, verification outcomes and completion times are identical across members.
A qualifying paired task exists.
Both members run the same copied task-capacity pair with the same technical result.
Executor identity and type, capacity owner and payee differ between members.
IA: executor, capacity owner, prospective payee and payee are one principal.
IA: the executor is a persistent economic principal.
IA: the payee for the copied capacity is its copied principal.
IA: the copy source is not paid.
IA: offer, post and reserve, bind provider, execute, verify, settle, release.
IB: capacity owner, prospective payee and payee are the founding source owner.
IB: the executor is a temporary, non-principal position.
IB: capacity owner differs from the temporary executor.
IB: the temporary executor never has an account.
IB: license, post and reserve, instantiate executor, execute, verify, settle, terminate, release.

run.interpretation: Constructive consistency and existence witness under one declared finite scenario. Differences between institutions are institutional (positions, rights, state, process, payees), not evidence of superiority; no elapsed-time, success-rate or concentration outcome is primary.
